desc: Ideation: use complement enumeration because C(N,K) <= 10^6 forces m = min(K, N-K) to be small.

Implement the full Python solution: parse input, compute total_xor, set m = min(K, N-K), enumerate all size-m subsets with an incremental recursive DFS (special-casing m=0 and m=1), update the answer directly in choose mode or as total_xor ^ omitted_xor in omit mode, and print the maximum.
Verify correctness and performance on samples and edge cases such as K=1, K=N, duplicates, all zeros, and cases near 10^6 combinations.
